authorization_record: User approved fixed-checkpoint clean/low-contrast paired evaluation; agent execution record, not a digital signature. No training or policy rollout.

protocol.dataset: Unchanged pinned LIBERO Spatial9/source39 fixed12 pack; evaluate original4 validation episodes only, all500 complete history4/horizon3 windows. No source replacement or row truncation.
protocol.features: Sequential524 clean replay then524 low-contrast rows, two views each,2096 actual view embeddings. Every clean latent must byte-match original cache, no tolerance. Only degraded history_visual_latent enters evaluation; future targets remain original clean cache.
protocol.frozen: All six final200 checkpoints kept; same task instruction, state8, action7, masks, train-only saved normalization and evaluation window/batch order. No fitting, optimizer construction, new checkpoint, or best-seed selection. Dataset independently recomputes train statistics only to verify the original artifact.
protocol.zero_arm: Exactly zero in normalized candidate-action coordinates during both evaluations; corresponds to raw training action mean, not physicalzero/hold.
protocol.clean_guard: All six model clean predictions/per-episode/macro/micro must exactly replay saved final200 before degraded evaluation. Full checkpoint binding retains original training authorization, not evaluation-plan authorization.
protocol.baselines: Both fixed action arms and parameter-free persistence; persistence uses each condition's last visual latent, state residual0, same original clean targets/support.
protocol.primary: Per-validation-episode normalized8D state MAE and episode-equal macro. Report low_contrast-clean and observed-zero absolute/relative changes for every seed/episode; average macros over3 fixed optimizer seeds with descriptive population std of paired differences.
protocol.secondary: Visual latent MAE/RMSE, normalized-state RMSE, unchanged masked objective, per-view/horizon/coordinate/same-unit and window-weighted micro. Separate state and visual sensitivity; no composite-only conclusion.
protocol.decision: Descriptively retain observed-action association only if observed beats normalizedzero AND persistence on degraded-state episode-macro for every seed. Report clean-to-degraded sensitivity irrespective of decision; no automatic tuning or robustness threshold/certification.
protocol.efficiency: GPU frozen image feature extraction, then separate CPU torch2.10.0+cu128 float32/threads1/deterministic/noAMP/TF32/CUDA evaluation. Record feature/load/hash and evaluation wall times; fixed order/warmup prevents comparative hardware-speed claims.
protocol.ablations: Only existing candidate-action ablation is carried forward. No history/state/vision knockout or new model module in this budget; do not claim their causal contribution. XAI is not a contribution.
protocol.visual_evidence: First/last frames of all4 validation episodes in both views, raw/processed clean/degraded; Chinese comparison sheet for representative visual inspection. User visual acceptance is separate.
protocol.recovery: Exclusive fixed feature/eval outputs, no overwrite/resume/automatic retry. Preserve partial traces/failure; inspect actual PID/status before considering a new attempt.

limitations: Only4 held-out episodes in one task; 3 optimizer seeds do not create12 independent data units. Descriptive results, no significance.
True state/action/history remain uncorrupted. Stable state MAE alone does not establish visual reliance or visual robustness.
Visual prediction has a latest-latent skip plus residual; degraded-input to clean-target error combines representation shift and prediction/denoising error, not pure dynamics error.
Low-contrast alpha.45 is deterministic and not calibrated vessel oxidation; fixedseed does not establish noise-seed stability. No severity sweep.
Unknown PI0.5 pretraining overlap and unverified source-family independence remain. Existing validation observations have been inspected.
No causal control effect, counterfactual candidate ranking, guidewire/Elite/Piper performance, policy success, tactile/contact, rotation, formal-readiness, or real-system claim.
runtime_estimate: Prior1658-row cache67.66s; sequential1048-row clean/degraded workload plus strict source/weight hashes/load and396 CPU model forwards conservatively3-4minutes as one logical job. Execute within current approved scope; no optimization.
planning_skill_scope: Experiment protocol checklist applied to engineering evaluation, not manuscript Results/Discussion; no mock metric, paper section or fabricated result.
